prep: ChloraPrep (2% CHG / 70% IPA) - abdomen from xiphoid to pubis, bilaterally to midaxillary lines. Timed 3-minute dry.
sutures: 0 Polysorb UR-6 on fascial closure
3-0 Monocryl Suture on PS-2 for subcuticular skin closure
Endoloop 0 Vicryl (on standby for cystic duct)
notes: Prefers Hassan open cut-down for umbilical port. Defogger must be heated. Veress needle not used. Keep dry lap ready for gallbladder extraction.

position: Supine with lateral leg positioner, thigh tourniquet, foot of bed dropped
prep: DuraPrep 2-layer, foot isolated with sterile impervious stockinette and Coban wrap
sutures: #1 Stratafix Spiral PDS for arthrotomy capsule
2-0 Vicryl on SH for subcutaneous tissue
Ethicon Proximate 35W Skin Stapler
implants: Zimmer Persona Modular Cruciate Retaining (CR) Component
notes: Tourniquet inflated to 250 mmHg prior to skin incision. Vancomycin cement mixed at 14 minutes. Tranexamic acid (TXA) 1g IV given at start and deflation.

procedure: Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) & Saphenous Vein Harvest
position: Supine with shoulder roll, bilateral legs frog-legged on gel pads for saphenous vein harvest, arms tucked at sides
prep: ChloraPrep chin-to-ankles circumferentially. 3-minute dry time strictly timed.
sutures: 7-0 Prolene Suture on BV-1 for distal LAD and circumflex anastomoses
6-0 Prolene Suture on C-1 for proximal aortic anastomoses
4-0 Prolene Suture on RB-1 for cannulation repair and vein graft side-branches
2-0 Prolene Suture on SH for aortic root purse-strings
3-0 Silk Suture for venous cannulation tie-down
notes: Dr. Sarah Chen wants 2 sharp Weitlaner retractors for vein harvest. Uses 3-0 Silk for venous cannulation tie-down and 7-0/6-0/4-0 Prolene for coronary grafting.

procedure: Carotid Endarterectomy & Peripheral Vascular Bypass (CABG / Vascular)
position: Supine with shoulder roll, head extended and rotated 30° away from operative side on gel donut
prep: ChloraPrep neck from jawline to nipples and ipsilateral groin prepped in field for vein harvest
sutures: 3-0 Silk Suture loaded on DeBakey for venous branch ligations
6-0 Prolene Suture on C-1 for bovine pericardial patch angioplasty
4-0 Prolene Suture on RB-1 for femoral and carotid arteriotomies
7-0 Prolene Suture on BV-1 for distal micro-vascular anastomosis
3-0 Monocryl Suture on PS-2 for subcuticular neck closure
implants: Bovine Pericardial Patch (1cm x 6cm) & Pruitt-Inahara Carotid Shunt on standby
notes: Dr. Patel prefers 3-0 Silk ties loaded directly on 12in DeBakey pickups. Heparin 5000 units IV given 3 minutes prior to carotid cross-clamp. Keep Custom Vascular Stapler in room.

surgeon: Dr. Marcus Vance, MD (Dr. Arthur Vance, MD)
position: Supine with chest roll, bilateral legs externally rotated (frog-leg) with knee rolls
prep: ChloraPrep chin-to-ankles circumferentially. 3-minute dry time strictly timed.
sutures: 7-0 Prolene Suture on BV-1 for distal coronary anastomoses
6-0 Prolene Suture on C-1 for proximal aortic anastomoses
2-0 Prolene Suture on SH double-armed for aortic root purse-strings
#5 Ethibond Sternal Closure Wires (x6 or x8)
3-0 Silk Suture on DeBakey for venous branch ligations
notes: Heparin 300 units/kg prior to cannulation; Target ACT > 480 sec. Cool chest with sterile saline slush. Have Protamine ready for pump separation.

position: Steep Trendelenburg (28°), Lithotomy with Allen Yellofin stirrups, arms tucked securely with foam pads
prep: ChloraPrep abdomen from nipples to mid-thighs, including genitalia. 3-minute dry.
instrumentation: Da Vinci Xi 8mm Large Needle Driver
sutures: 3-0 V-Loc 180 barbed suture for vesicourethral anastomosis
2-0 Vicryl on SH for dorsal venous complex ligation
3-0 Monocryl Suture on PS-2 for port sites
notes: Verify zero pressure on brachial plexus before docking. Confirm bladder integrity with 200 mL sterile saline instillation via 3-way Foley.

position: Prone on Wilson frame or Jackson table, abdomen completely hanging free to minimize epidural venous pressure
prep: Betadine scrub & paint (or ChloraPrep) - lower thoracic to sacrum
sutures: 0 Vicryl (Polysorb UR-6 Suture) for lumbodorsal fascia
2-0 Vicryl on SH for subcutaneous layer
3-0 Monocryl Suture on PS-2 for subcuticular skin closure
notes: Have Surgicel and thrombin-soaked Gelfoam patties ready for epidural bleeding. Microscope brought in from patient right side.

position: Supine with arms out on armboards at 90° for rapid bilateral vascular access
prep: Rapid ChloraPrep or Betadine paint - chin to mid-thighs bilaterally
sutures: 0 Vicryl (Polysorb UR-6 Suture) for mass abdominal closure
0 Silk Suture on CT-1 for heavy pedicle ligation
3-0 Silk Suture for bowel oversewing
Ethicon Proximate 35W Skin Stapler
implants: Bogota bag / ABThera Open Abdomen VAC dressing ready on standby
notes: Warm room to 78°F. Level 1 rapid infuser primed. Count softs by 10s. Four quadrants packed with laparotomy sponges immediately upon entry.

gloves: Biogel Surgeons 7.5 with radiation attenuation overgloves
position: Supine on radiolucent carbon fiber fluoroscopy table
prep: ChloraPrep bilateral groins and entire abdomen to knees
sutures: 4-0 Prolene Suture on RB-1 for femoral transverse arteriotomy
3-0 Monocryl Suture on PS-2 for groin cutdowns
implants: Bifurcated Aortic Endograft + Contralateral Iliac Limb
notes: Systemic heparinization 100 units/kg prior to sheath insertion. Target ACT > 250 sec. Power injector filled with Isovue-370 contrast.
